cases.title: Moon Garden
cases.label: One missing angle
cases.lesson: Canvas arc needs a start angle and an end angle. The greenhouse circle supplied only one.
cases.note: The recorded repair also updates frame timing and keyboard start/restart handling.
cases.prompt: Moon Garden: a cozy arcade game about a tiny astronaut collecting floating seeds on a round little moon. Arrow keys or WASD move, with large visible touch direction buttons. Carry three seeds back to the glowing greenhouse to win. Avoid two slow drifting moon moths; three collisions lose. Draw a beautiful warm ivory, emerald and golden night garden with Canvas. Show a clear seed counter, hearts, instructions and Start/Restart buttons. Make movement immediately obvious and controls forgiving.

cases.title: Bee Bop
cases.label: One extra parenthesis
cases.lesson: The fillText call closes before its x and y coordinates. Move the closing parenthesis after both coordinates.
cases.note: An earlier attempt in this trajectory also lacked the required game interface. This case starts from the next complete candidate.
cases.prompt: Bee Bop: a cheerful arcade game controlling a round bee in a little garden. Move with arrows/WASD or touch direction buttons, collect six pollen dots and carry them to the hive. Avoid two slowly patrolling beetles; three hits lose. Flowers pulse gently and every pollen pickup gives a clear satisfying visual change. Use an original sunny yellow and coral Canvas illustration style, visible controls, score, hearts, Start and Restart. Make the first pickup close enough to reach quickly.

cases.title: Cloud Courier
cases.label: Canvas is not chainable
cases.lesson: Canvas arc and ellipse return undefined. Call ctx.fill() separately, rather than chaining .fill().
cases.note: The recorded repair also restores vertical keyboard movement and corrects a letter rotation expression.
cases.prompt: Keep this Cloud Courier game intact and fix exactly its keyboard vertical movement. In update(dt), dy currently uses only held touch directions. Mirror dx: dy must include both keyboard.down and held.has('down') for positive motion, and keyboard.up and held.has('up') for negative motion. Preserve the working horizontal movement, phone controls, cooldown, letter collection, mailbox delivery, all three lives, finite snapshot API and one loop. Do not rewrite unrelated mechanics. Return complete HTML.
